text: CHIAMYS, in anitantly, a military habit worn by the ancient over the tunes. It belonged to the participants; and was the name in the time of war that the topa was in the time of peace. This sort of gown was called _picking_, from the rich embodies with figures in Ehryvan work; and _purpersen_, because the grand-work was purple. The chlamycles of the empreors were all purple, adorned with a golden and embroder-el border.
